title: The Misra-Benedetti wire and its operational twin (paraphrase, secondary)

transactions.description: WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary): $500,000 wire originating from Misra; Misra spokesman characterized payment as 'oil investment.' Bank record not in public domain. No SAR, no DPA exhibit, no FCA notice references this wire. Source: WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary).

WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary): BVI exempted-company recipient; not in OpenCorporates, no LEI, no public BVI registry portal entry. Sibling vehicle Barkmere Limited Cyprus (HE 338259) corroborated via Aleph. Source: WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary).

WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary): Benedetti as beneficial controller of Barkmere Group. Funds tied by WSJ to recruitment of K2 Intelligence London for research and pressure operations against Nikesh Arora. Source: WSJ Feb 2020 (paraphrase, secondary).

Project Spring comparator: GBP 336,000 fees + GBP 130,400 expenses paid by BVI shell Wetherby Select to K2 London for four-year covert infiltration of anti-asbestos campaigner network. Settled Nov 2018 UK High Court. This supports a narrower parallel: same period, same London K2 vehicle, same BVI-paymaster pattern, but public records do not prove the same office or team handled the SoftBank work. Source: Leigh Day press release Nov 2018; Hazards Magazine; Kazan-Allen v K2 Intelligence Ltd (UK High Court).

Adjacent (context): Epstein wires $500K to Boies Schiller on Indyke instruction five weeks before the Jan 26 2019 'caper' thread. Same firm signed the Jan 2016 SoftBank anonymous-shareholder letter and appears for Virginia Giuffre in 2016 Giuffre v Maxwell docket materials. Source: Epstein corpus EFTA02613052 (direct quote); Justia docket materials.
